why: Making cuts inside multi-word personal names or name+appositive especially severe caused the model to avoid splitting names (helping mid-length budgets: ≤5 and ≤7 showed small gains) but it also re-ranked the very top candidate cut positions (rank_depth 1..3 all fell), so for the shortest latency bins (≤3) the prompt now prefers earlier, worse splits of nearby noun phrases and determiners and H_set dropped there.
lesson: When increasing severity for name-internal cuts, ensure the change does not re-rank the first one or two candidate cuts (short-latency depths), since that can force harmful early splits of adjacent noun phrases/determiners and degrade short-bin performance.
